subtitle: A tiny game of perfect timing
promotionalText: Set it. Pull it. Stop it just in time. Chase perfect toast, build your streak, and earn your way to DAYDREAM.
description:
Small slice. Big potential.

Toastyy turns a little toaster into a game of timing and nerve. Turn the knob, pull the lever, and stop the toast as late as you dare—before it burns.

FIND YOUR PERFECT STOP
Learn the toaster’s rhythm across four difficulty settings. Save each slice, build a streak, and chase your best score.

FEEL THE HEAT
A detailed 3D toaster, playful sounds, and haptic feedback bring every round to life. Sound and haptics can be switched off independently.

EARN YOUR DAYDREAM
Start with Dry toast and work toward one ambitious milestone: 1,000,000 XP unlocks the iridescent DAYDREAM skin. Your XP, collection, and records stay on your device.

QUICK ROUNDS. ONE MORE TRY.
No account required. Just you, a toaster, and the temptation to wait a little longer.

Toastyy is free to download and includes advertising between runs. An optional, one-time Remove Ads purchase removes advertising permanently. Purchases can be restored from Settings. No subscription.
notes:
Toastyy is a timing game with no account or sign-in. Turn the knob to choose a difficulty, then tap or pull the side lever to begin. Tap the orange STOP TOASTER control before the round ends; allowing the timer to expire burns the toast. Each attempt earns local XP. The collection opens from the card below the toaster. DAYDREAM is the only unlockable skin and requires 1,000,000 total XP.

Settings can be opened using the question-mark button or the toaster’s Settings control. The non-consumable com.toastyy.app.removeads is available from Settings, with Restore Purchases beside it. Sounds and haptics have separate controls.

Advertising is frequency limited to breaks after burnt runs, after at least six rounds and two minutes, and never interrupts active play. If an ad cannot load or consent is unavailable, gameplay continues. Purchasers receive no ads.
